_comment: Dated NSE contract rules for NIFTY, used by the cascade replay and backtest.
Copy this file to data/nse_contract_rules.json and CORRECT THE VALUES against
the NSE circulars before trusting any replay that crosses a change. The rows
below are placeholders with plausible shapes, not verified history.
Why this file exists: expiry weekday and lot size are exchange policy and have
both moved inside recent twelve-month windows. No amount of price data can
derive them, and a replay that assumes today's rules will pick the wrong
expiry and size every contract wrongly for the whole stretch before a change,
silently. A range starting before the earliest row here is refused outright
expiry_weekday: Monday=0, Tuesday=1, Wednesday=2, Thursday=3, Friday=4.
Market-holiday shifts are NOT listed here. They are read back from the trading
sessions present in the index candles, which cannot drift out of date.

rules.note: PLACEHOLDER - Thursday weekly expiry period. Verify weekday, lot size and start date.
PLACEHOLDER - Wednesday weekly expiry period. Verify weekday, lot size and start date.
PLACEHOLDER - Tuesday weekly expiry, the rule this repository already assumes.
